name: 集体（土地/征收/评估）要求

map.📋 集体（土地/征收/评估）要求: 📋 Collective Land Expropriation and Valuation Requirements
map.集体土地征收补偿计算工具，根据土地补偿费、安置补助费、地上附着物补偿和青苗补偿费: A compensation calculator for collective land expropriation, deriving the total from land compensation, resettlement subsidy, above-ground attachments and standing crops.
map.📖 查看「集体（土地/征收/评估）要求 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Collective Land Expropriation and Valuation Requirements User Guide"
map.前三年平均年产值(元/亩): Average annual output value of the past three years (yuan/mu)
map.需安置农业人口数: Number of agricultural residents to be resettled
map.土地补偿费为该耕地前三年平均年产值的6-10倍: Land compensation is 6-10 times the average annual output value of the cultivated land over the past three years
map.安置补助费按需安置人口计算，每人4-6倍年产值: The resettlement subsidy is computed per person resettled at 4-6 times annual output value
map.土地补偿费和安置补助费总和不超过30倍年产值: Land compensation plus resettlement subsidy may not exceed 30 times annual output value
map.地上附着物按实际价值补偿，青苗按当季产值补偿: Above-ground attachments are compensated at actual value and standing crops at the current season's output value
map.征地项目测算土地补偿费、安置补助费与青苗补偿。: Estimate land compensation, resettlement subsidy and crop compensation for an expropriation project.
map.核对补偿总额是否超过年产值 30 倍上限。: Check whether total compensation exceeds the cap of 30 times annual output value.
map.被征地农民核算人均安置补助是否合理。: Help expropriated farmers check whether per-capita resettlement subsidy is reasonable.
map.前 3 年平均年产值 2000 元/亩、征收 50 亩、土地倍数 8 → 土地补: Average annual output value over the past 3 years of 2000 yuan/mu, 50 mu expropriated, land multiple 8: land compensation = 2000 × 8 × 50 = 800,000 yuan; resettlement multiple 5 with 30 people gives subsidy = 2000 × 5 × 30 = 300,000; crops at 1000 yuan/mu × 50 = 50,000; total 1.15 million yuan.
map.土地+安置补偿 = 年产值×(8+5×30/50)×50；若该和超过年产值×30: Land plus resettlement compensation = annual output value × (8 + 5 × 30/50) × 50; if that exceeds annual output value × 30 × 50 the cap is reached and the safeguard standard must be raised as the law requires.
map.补偿倍数怎么定？: How are the compensation multiples set?
map.土地补偿费一般为前 3 年平均年产值 6–10 倍，安置补助费每人 4–6 倍，: Land compensation is generally 6-10 times the average annual output value of the past 3 years and the resettlement subsidy 4-6 times per person, applied under the provincial integrated district land price.
map.补偿不够生活怎么办？: What if compensation does not cover living costs?
map.规定土地与安置补助总和不得超过年产值 30 倍，若仍不足以保障原有生活水平，应经: Land plus resettlement subsidy may not exceed 30 times annual output value; where that still fails to maintain the original standard of living, raise the standard on approval or arrange social security.
map.关于「集体（土地/征收/评估）要求」: About "Collective Land Expropriation and Valuation Requirements"
map.集体土地征收补偿计算工具根据土地补偿费、安置补助费、地上附着物补偿和青苗补偿费四: The calculator derives total expropriation compensation from land compensation, resettlement subsidy, above-ground attachments and standing crops, under the relevant provisions of the Land Administration Law.
